supply: VDD = VDDH = 3.3 V from the lead (key module) or the Pico (hub); REG1 DC/DC may be enabled (inductor in the module); USB VBUS feeds only the USB regulator

SCK.note: SPI clock to the expander(s), 33 R at the pod

MOSI.note: 33 R at the pod; in the hub: UART TX of the pod (to GP1)

MISO.note: in the hub: UART RX of the pod (from GP0)

CS.note: active low, 100 k pull-up on the pod

INT.note: expander interrupt, open drain, active low, 100 k pull-up on the pod; wake source

LED_DATA.note: to the 5 V level shifter (74AHCT1G125), 100 k pull-down; hold low while the key board's LED rail is off

HUB_DETECT.note: through 1 k to bay pin 6: tied low on the hub carrier, open on a key board; read once with the internal pull-up, then pull-up off, never drive

EN_5V.note: high = LED rail converter on; 100 k pull-down on the power board (off by default)

VBAT_SENSE.note: AIN2; pack voltage x 680 / 2880 (2.2 M / 680 k), 100 nF at the pin: sample slowly

STATUS_LED.note: high = on (1 k, LED to GND)

RESET.note: nRESET: button to GND, debug header pin 10; works only once UICR PSELRESET[0] and [1] select P0.18

pack_cutoff.note: hardware, on the 3.3 V converter; drop EN_5V at about 1.1 V per cell in firmware

vbat.note: reads 0 while the pack switch is off (then the pod is unpowered too); in the hub the pin is open

led_rail.note: TPS2553 constant-current cap; keep the firmware's LED budget below 450 mA

hub.note: HUB_DETECT reads low; hub firmware must not start I2C0 on GP0 / GP1 with a carrier fitted (hub-pinmap.json lists them as I2C0); the Pico's I2C0 pull-ups (4.7 k) hold both lines high; CS, SCK, INT go to SP1, SP2, SP3 (no Pico pin)
